接下来的排查策略需要彻底调整，不再找固定空间，改找移动载体，重点目标：北角汇警戒三角区域内所有活跃的雪糕车。

他发动车子，驶出停车场。

从北角汇出发，沿着英皇道慢慢开，目光扫两侧街道。

第一辆雪糕车出现在渣华道路口——一辆红白相间的小货车，车身上画着卡通甜筒图案，售卖窗口前排着三四个小朋友。开车的是个头发花白的阿伯，五十多岁，满脸褶子，笑呵呵地给小朋友挖雪糕球。

不是这个。

第二辆在电照街中段——蓝色车身，车顶装了个旋转的雪糕模型，窗口坐着一个胖胖的中年女人在刷手机，天珠没有反应。

不是。

第三辆在北角码头附近——绿色车身，没有太多装饰，比前两辆旧得多，车窗口挂着手写的价目牌，但窗口没有人，车停在路边，像是暂时离开了。

顾承安把车停在五十米开外，等了一会儿。

大约四分钟后，一个穿围裙的男人从旁边的公共厕所走出来，回到绿色雪糕车旁边。

中年男性，身高大约一米七，偏瘦，本地面孔。

天珠没反应。

不是。

顾承安继续往前开，又转了差不多一个小时，找到了第四辆和第五辆。

第四辆在春秧街市场入口，经营者是对夫妻档；第五辆在糖水道，全部排除。

天色渐暗，晚上七点半，顾承安在北角汇附近找了家茶餐厅吃了碗云吞面，一边吃一边想。

五辆雪糕车，全部排除。

但他没有气馁，原因很简单——移动贩卖车的活动时间有早晚之分，他今天从傍晚开始找，有些车可能下午就收摊了，有些可能只在上午出来。

明天还得继续，换时间段，换路线，把这片区域不同时段活跃的所有雪糕车全部过一遍。

吃完面，他没有立刻回鹏城，而是开车在北角汇周边又转了一圈。

晚上八点四十分。

他路过书局街的时候，看到了第六辆。

白色车身，车况中等偏旧，侧面喷着“Mr.SOftee”的字样和一个戴厨师帽的卡通人物——这是港岛最常见的雪糕车品牌形象。售卖窗口亮着一盏小灯，但没有顾客。窗口后面坐着一个人，低头在看什么。

顾承安放慢车速，从旁边驶过。

The next investigation strategy needs to be completely adjusted. Instead of looking for fixed spaces, we will look for mobile carriers. The key target is: all active ice cream trucks in the North Point Hui warning triangle area.

He started the car and drove out of the parking lot.

Starting from North Point Hui, drive slowly along King's Road and scan the streets on both sides.

The first ice cream truck appeared at the intersection of Java Road - a red and white minivan with cartoon cone patterns painted on the body, and three or four children lined up in front of the sales window.The driver was a gray-haired uncle, in his fifties, with a wrinkled face, and he was digging ice cream balls for the children with a smile.

That's not it.

The second car is in the middle of Dianzhao Street - it has a blue body and a rotating ice cream model on the roof. There is a fat middle-aged woman sitting at the window checking her mobile phone, but Dzi Bead is not responding.

no.

The third one is near the North Point Pier - it has a green body, not many decorations, and is much older than the first two. There is a handwritten price tag hanging on the window, but there is no one at the window. The car is parked on the side of the road, as if it has left temporarily.

Gu Chengan parked the car fifty meters away and waited for a while.

About four minutes later, a man in an apron walked out of the nearby public toilet and returned to the green ice cream truck.

A middle-aged man, about 1.7 meters tall, thin, with a local appearance.

Dzi beads didn't respond.

no.

Gu Chengan continued to drive forward, and after driving around for almost an hour, he found the fourth and fifth cars.

The fourth one is at the entrance of the Chunyang Street market, and is run by a husband and wife team; the fifth one is on Tangshui Road, so all are excluded.

It was getting dark. At 7:30 in the evening, Gu Chengan found a tea restaurant near Beijiaohui and ate a bowl of wonton noodles, thinking as he ate.

Five ice cream trucks, all excluded.

But he was not discouraged. The reason was simple - the mobile vending carts were active in the morning and evening. He started looking for them in the evening today. Some carts might close their stalls in the afternoon, while others might only come out in the morning.

We have to continue tomorrow, change the time period, change the route, and visit all the ice cream trucks active in this area at different times.

After eating the noodles, he did not return to Pengcheng immediately, but drove around Beijiaohui again.

8:40 p.m.

When he passed by Shuju Street, he saw the sixth one.

The car has a white body and is in medium to old condition. The words "Mr. SOftee" and a cartoon character wearing a chef's hat are spray-painted on the side - this is the most common ice cream truck brand image in Hong Kong Island.A small light was on at the sales window, but there were no customers.There was a man sitting behind the window, looking down at something.

Gu Chengan slowed down and drove past.
